notes.title: Resources in Chronocracy: what to dig, what to chew, what to smelt
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]The Chronocracy team keeps working away, and today we’ve got a new post for you about the resources in the game. What and how to gather so that your little folk don’t starve or freeze, and don’t fall prey to hostile neighbors or dangerous aliens.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.ibb.co/d1Gnrr6/Chron-2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]At the start, you have access to basic resources: stone, wood, and food. That’s enough to get by and survive the dark times, while you haven’t yet taught your wards to extract more complex resources — let alone smelt one resource into another.[/p][p][/p][p]Once you research the right sciences, progress will take off in giant leaps (or tiny steps, since your babies’ legs are teeny-tiny), and you’ll be able to mine various useful minerals underground.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.ibb.co/HDn2cpKB/Chron-1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To do that, you’ll need to build a mine, train your residents to conduct geological surveys to search for minerals, and then actually start extracting them.[/p][p][/p][p]The underground is full of everything you might need for production — for example: diamonds, lead, copper. Some things are more common, some rarer. The rarest resources, such as rubies, lie very deep and are surrounded by scorching magma. Be careful when mining them — don’t accidentally roast your little ones! Shortages can be made up for at the market by buying the resource you need for gold.[/p][p][/p][p]The next stage is learning how to create resources.[/p][p]
[img src="https://i.ibb.co/7JHNx2mk/Chron-4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can do this in the smelter, at the chemical plant, the power station, and the collider. Just make sure you don’t accidentally create a black hole, or your civilization will meet its end faster than your tea can brew.[/p][p][/p][p]There’s also a special underground resource — metamaterial. This is a key resource for victory, hunted by every inhabitant of the planet… and beyond! There are legends about its unusual properties, but only one thing is known for sure: it’s needed for the final invention on which the survival of the entire civilization depends. In addition, this resource is required to create Titans, which we talked about in the previous post, so you’ll have to mine it, stockpile it, and spend it wisely (or unwisely, if you enjoy risk and adrenaline).[/p][p][/p][p]Add Chronocracy to your Wishlist, join our [url="https://discord.gg/m6rnQMmtM2"]Discord [/url]where you can mine the freshest news about the game and its development — and sometimes memes we craft with extra care![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Armed with pickaxes,[/p][p] The Chronocracy Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Whose shoulders does civilization in Chronocracy rest upon?
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone!
[/p][p]This is the Chronocracy team speaking, straight from the future, the past, and the present (yes, we know how to do three things at once!) While we’re busy eliminating the ancient universal enemy — micromanagement in the administration of your settlement — we’ll tell you about the cute creatures whose fate will be in your hands.[/p][p][/p][p]At this stage of development, there are three types of units in the game:[/p][list][*][p]Workers;[/p][/*][*][p]Warriors;[/p][/*][*][p]Titans (who are technically warriors too, but special ones, with a “WOW, that’s huge” effect).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Workers [/b]are ordinary inhabitants, the basic type of unit, and they make up the majority of the city’s population.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.ibb.co/Gv2x00d4/Chron-workers.gif"][/img][/p][p]Despite being small, restless, and wearing bunny slippers, they can do all kinds of things — both simple and complex: gather resources, study sciences, establish diplomatic relations, work in the market, the smelter, on farms, in lumber mills, and other production buildings. In short, they’re masters of all trades!
[/p][p][b]Warriors[/b] are those armed with spears, bows, chainsaws, and other high-risk items. Obviously, they defend the city from predators, aggressive neighbors, and alien invaders.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.ibb.co/BVKRrSXB/Chron-riders.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In the early eras, warriors are simple: infantry, spearmen, archers, and riders on plumpbirds (yes, they coo when they charge into battle).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.ibb.co/21LnYqth/Chron-warriors-1.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://i.ibb.co/6JsHtc5h/Chron-warriors-2.gif"][/img][/p][p]As you progress to more advanced eras, you’ll be able to create more advanced defenders: stormtroopers and cyborgs, tanks and starships.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.ibb.co/jkgpYtXV/Chron-titans.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Titans [/b]are experimental combat superwarriors capable of turning the tide of battle in your favor. Creating them requires a special resource — metamaterial. But it’s worth it — in the fight against alien invaders from the depths of space, they have no equal.[/p][p][/p][p]Add Chronocracy to your Wishlist, join our [url="https://discord.gg/m6rnQMmtM2"]Discord[/url], and don’t forget to put on your bunny slippers before you saddle up your fluffbird![/p][p][/p][p]With hopes for fruitful cooperation,[/p][p]the Chronocracy Team[/p][p](where everyone is a little worker, a little warrior, and always — a titan)[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Chronocracy World Guide: Stones, Dunes, Plumpbirds & Beyond
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone!
[/p][p]We’re deep in development on Chronocracy — polishing gameplay, adding new mechanics, and balancing everything that moves. More details coming in future posts.
[/p][p]Today, we’d like to share a bit more about the world where the game takes place. Let's start with the first five biomes. Each has its own pros, cons, and surprises, so choose wisely. Every location offers a different amount of starting resources, which can speed up or slow down your progress right from the beginning.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Desert[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469451/983de7b79f60371960af9c2431744d332dc378d6.png"][/img][/p][p]Heat, sun, sand, and palm trees! Beautiful — with one small exception: there’s a sharp shortage of stone, and this region is poor in useful minerals. But you can get a golden tan and meditate in the dunes.
[/p][h3][b]North Pole[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469451/ba7f614b0a431859017e9b189e41e4c3b0710057.png"][/img][/p][p]A cold place with almost everything — except food. Seriously, food is a quest. Finding something to eat early on might be harder than in any other biome. Build farms right away, or get ready to gnaw on ice and chew your own boots.
[/p][h3][b]Relict Forest[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469451/cb652e5d9f98b8db28ab2600cdc686df00fdc0f4.png"][/img][/p][p]A very beautiful location full of unusual plants, massive trees, lush vegetation, and mystical vibes. There’s plenty of stone, wood, and food here, but this area attracts large plumpbirds. And they can be aggressive, causing trouble during construction or resource gathering. You’ll need to create warriors capable of attacking these giant round feathered creatures.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Stone Tundra[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469451/465452fe48e5c61177d65ba03c599c9342cb08b5.png"][/img][/p][p]The name says it all: lots of stone, not much else. You’ll have to go far for wood, and there’s a risk of running into predators or hostile tribes. The choice is yours: become a roaming wanderer or build sawmills as fast as you can.
[/p][h3][b]Giant Green Vaults[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469451/7f572d970ecd5ccac08e03894a7cae65768681b4.png"][/img][/p][p]An unusual place to live in the shade of tall stone ledges. The same mysterious atmosphere as the Relict Forest, but with less stone. Fans of greenery will love it.[/p][p][/p][p]Have you already picked the perfect place to survive? Tell us in the comments where you’d start your chronoadventure!
[/p][p]Don’t forget to add Chronocracy to your wishlist, follow the game’s page, and join our [url="https://discord.gg/m6rnQMmtM2"]Discord[/url] — it’s cozy, fun, and full of useful stuff.[/p][p]
[/p][p]From the heart of the Relict Forest,[/p][p]The Chronocracy Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Who Lives in the Mysterious Forests of Chronocracy?
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The Chronocracy team is here, and we’re excited to start introducing you to the world of our game — from behind-the-scenes peeks at development to the wild and wonderful stories that bring it all to life.

Let’s begin with the locals — the creatures who call this strange and beautiful land their home.
Today’s spotlight: the fauna. Strange, whimsical, and sometimes downright terrifying.

[h3][b]Plumpbirds [/b][/h3]
Picture this: a living fluffball with stubby wings, a chubby beak, and eyes so huge they seem to reflect all the stars in the universe. That’s a Plumpbirds  — easily the most unforgettable inhabitant of Chronocracy’s tropical forests.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/SwJn3p2y/image.gif[/img]

But don’t let their cuteness fool you. Plumpbirds are famously temperamental and quick to rage. Step onto their turf — or worse, mess with their eggs — and they’ll launch into an explosive attack.
Legend has it they store gas inside their bodies their entire lives, which explains their balloon-like shape… and their tendency to go boom.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/9mcsVjwZ/image.gif[/img]

There are two kinds:
[list]
[*] Wild Plumpbirds — bigger, fiercer, and always ready to throw down.
[*] Domesticated Plumpbirds — slightly more chill and used as as a means of transportation by riders. 
[/list]
[h3][b]Gas-stingray[/b][/h3]
Now look up. See those enormous shapes drifting across the sky like airborne whales? Those are Gas-stingray — ancient, floating beings that never seem to touch the ground.

They hum and echo with ghostly sounds that might be songs... or warnings... or cosmic gossip no one understands.

No one’s quite sure what they eat — or if they eat at all. Some scholars believe they’ve left the material world behind and feed solely on pure life energy.
Alien, majestic and a little creepy.

[h3][b]The Flesh[/b][/h3]
Next up — the tastiest creature around. Say hello to the Flesh — soft, fragrant, and adored by nearly every culture across the land.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/HDxVTsRz/image.gif[/img]

You’ll find them in almost every climate — except the cold (they hate the cold).
They come in all kinds of colors, live off plants and bugs, and every now and then... they lay larvae.

[h3][b]The Larvae[/b][/h3]
Cute? No.
Safe? Not even a little.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/QjzTR6hb/image.gif[/img]

These little nightmares are pure instinct and hunger — born predators that attack anything that moves.
If you’re heading into their territory, don’t go unarmed. You’ll need a sword. Or ten.

Tell us in the comments which creature captured your heart (or gave you goosebumps).
And don’t forget to:
[list]
[*] Add Chronocracy to your Wishlist.
[*] Join our [url=https://discord.gg/m6rnQMmtM2]Discord[/url] for sneak peeks, dev updates, and behind-the-scenes content.
[/list]
With explosive love and ghostly howls,
The Chronocracy Team

notes.title: Flat World, Plump Birds and Time-Travel! Meet Chronocracy
notes.content:
Hey there, friends! 

We’re thrilled to introduce Chronocracy – an exhilarating real-time strategy game where you’ll take charge of a small tribe, developing its civilization and fighting for survival on a quirky flat disc!

[previewyoutube=-F1nOjwdNA4;full][/previewyoutube]

In Chronocracy, you will get to:
[list]
[*] Ensure the prosperity of your tribe by wisely managing resources and defending your cities from foes.
[*] Explore both the surface of the planet and its underground depths.
[*] Gather and produce a variety of resources.
[*] Build cities and colonize the planet, expanding your territory.
[*] Engage in battles against neighboring tribes and mysterious enemies from the future.
[*] Travel through time to rewrite the destiny of your tribe.
[/list]
Are you ready to answer the call of time and build a powerful civilization in Chronocracy? Add the game to your Wishlist, subscribe for updates, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/m6rnQMmtM2]Discord[/url] community so you won't miss any important news! Let’s move forward to great achievements! 

Best regards,  
The Chronocracy Team
